selection.dungeon_ring_alternative: Keep Soul 151641; compare Sephuz 132452 with Apex 137382 when frequent successful interrupts/CC activate Sephuz.
selection.damage_alternative: Consider Convergence of Fates 140806 instead of the defensive Archimonde trinket, based on actual item level and performance; no claim of a measured DPS winner.
selection.cloak: No BM-specific damage Legendary cloak. Do not recommend MM 151803 or Survival 151807 as a BM effect. Use an appropriate Agility cloak; at 110 consider T21 152131 together with its set.
selection.tier_caveat: Replacing every armor slot with orange gear can lose a valuable four-piece bonus. No unlimited-Legendary versus T21 full-gear simulation was run.

excluded.reason: Velen's Future Sight is a healing-effect trinket, not the BM damage choice.
Insignia of the Grand Army depends on the actual unlocked Netherlight Crucible traits; not a generic ring upgrade for a boosted character without them.

Aman'Thul's Vision requires 110. Ordinary proc has a route; the dedicated empowered Pantheon implementation is commented out and no live binding to 256832 was found. Not fully implemented/verified; excluded from recommendation.
Golganneth's Vitality is a Pantheon raid trinket; do not count on its empowered party effect for this universal quest/dungeon recommendation.

priority_notes: This is a conditional priority list, not a fixed repeating cast order.
Maintain Dire Frenzy attack-speed stacks (up to 3, 8-second native buff), refreshing near expiry and avoiding wasted charges; do not empty both charges blindly.
Use Bestial Wrath and pair Aspect of the Wild when available; do not waste entire cooldown cycles waiting for a perfect pairing.
Kill Command is the main single-target attack. During Bestial Wrath, Killer Cobra permits Kill Command -> Cobra Shot -> Kill Command when resources and pet/target state allow.
Maintain Parsel with Cobra Shot before its 8-second buff expires, while preserving Focus for Kill Command and necessary Multi-Shot.

With Titanstrike and the learned Titan's Thunder power, use Titan's Thunder during burst before the next Dire Frenzy; the native DF version buffs that next frenzy. It is not automatically available without the artifact.
For clustered enemies, maintain the pet's four-second Beast Cleave with Multi-Shot, then continue priority-target attacks; refresh Beast Cleave before expiry instead of blindly spamming Multi-Shot.
Use Crows on a target that dies during its 15-second duration for a cooldown reset. Native 131894 duration is 15000ms; the 16-tick damage expression is not the duration.
Misdirect to pet for solo, tank for dungeons; disable pet Growl autocast with a tank. Counter Shot is utility and can legitimately activate Sephuz; avoid wasting it merely to chase a buff.
Posthaste/Disengage and Cheetah provide movement; Turtle prevents attacking while active; Feign Death/Mask and Exhilaration are defensive tools. Orc Blood Fury can join burst.
No modern Barbed Shot or modern talent-tree recommendations are imported.
